# Dimensure

> Dimensure is a laser scan, drone and GNSS survey company (measured building, topographical, as-built, floor flatness, drone mapping, volume, setting out and construction quality-control surveys) based in Corby, Northamptonshire, UK. It scans estate roads, house plots, buildings and gardens with a Trimble X9 survey-grade terrestrial laser scanner and reports whether what has been built matches the design, and maps larger areas by drone tied to RTK GNSS ground control. It can also process survey data supplied by a client or the client's own engineer (laser scans, drone surveys, total station or GPS levels) and report it against design without a site visit.

Key facts:

- Services: Dimensure Design Audit (pre-construction review of groundworks and civils drawings for any project, including housing, commercial, industrial and infrastructure; used by designers and engineers, housebuilders, main contractors, and groundworks/civils contractors: levels, drainage, foundations, cross-drawing clashes; graded issue log with suggested fixes for the designer and indicative fix costs; from £495 per site); road and sub-base laser scanning against design levels; tarmac (asphalt) depth surveys by before-and-after scan comparison; plot and oversite surveys (slab flatness, brickwork dimensions to drawing, drain collar positions); as-built surveys of finished roads, drainage covers, plots and external works with as-built drawings; floor flatness surveys of slabs and screeds against BS 8204 SR classes or the specified flatness class; measured building surveys (floor plans, elevations, sections); topographical surveys for planning and design; garden surveys; drone surveys (orthophoto, surface model, contours, point cloud, fixed to RTK GNSS ground control with checked accuracy, typically 30-50 mm in level on open hard ground); stockpile volume surveys by drone (m³ and tonnes per pile); earthworks volume surveys (cut and fill against design or a previous survey, topsoil strip, muck-away checks); construction progress drone surveys (monthly controlled orthophoto and fixed-viewpoint photos); RTK GNSS setting out and site control on Ordnance Survey National Grid (typically 10-20 mm plan, 20-30 mm level); as-laid surveys of drainage, chambers and ducts in open trench before backfill; pre-start and post-completion condition surveys of highways and neighbouring properties (laser scan, drone, referenced photos, defect schedule); drone roof surveys (inspection and measured roof report).
- Reporting from client survey data: Dimensure does not have to carry out the survey. Clients can send their own engineer's scans, drone surveys or levels and get the same QC report (heat-maps, pass/fail, thickness, flatness, measured drawings); no site visit, available anywhere in the UK, fixed price per job after seeing the data.
- Areas served: the whole of the Midlands as standard (travel included within 50 miles of Corby, e.g. Northampton, Leicester, Coventry, Nottingham, Peterborough, Milton Keynes, Bedford, Cambridge); anywhere else in the UK with travel charged.
- Quality: scans are processed by software, then every report is checked by the Dimensure team, who sense-check results against drawings and site and flag problems.
- Equipment: Trimble X9, manufacturer-specified 2 mm range accuracy and 2.3 mm 3D point accuracy at 10 m; every report states the registration error for the job. Survey drone with a 1-inch sensor and an RTK GNSS rover; drone surveys state their accuracy checked against independent ground check points. Drone flights follow UK Civil Aviation Authority rules.
- Turnaround: road and plot QC reports normally the next working day; measured building and garden surveys 3-5 working days.
- Guide prices (before VAT): plot checks from £85 per plot (4+ plots per visit); road scans from £495 per visit; tarmac depth surveys from £895 per section; measured building surveys from £325; topographical surveys from £595; as-built surveys from £595 per visit; floor flatness surveys from £325 (floors up to 2,500 m² from £595); garden surveys from £395; drone surveys from £450 (up to ~1 ha) and £850 (up to ~5 ha); stockpile surveys from £395 per visit (from £295 on a regular programme); earthworks volume surveys from £595 (repeat surveys from £395); progress surveys from £295 per visit (single visit from £395); GNSS setting out from £325 per half day and £550 per day (site control from £395); as-laid surveys from £325 per visit; condition surveys from £395; drone roof surveys from £175 (with measured roof report from £295; commercial from £450).
- Scope note: plot checks do not verify plot position on the site grid or level to site datum; those remain with the site engineer.
- Set up by a groundworks project manager with 12 years on UK housing sites (NVQ Level 6 Construction Contracting Operations Management, SMSTS, CSCS Black card).
- Contact: info@dimensure.co.uk, https://dimensure.co.uk/contact.html

## Services

- [Road Level Surveys | Sub-base & Binder Laser Scan Surveys | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/road-level-surveys.html): Road level surveys of sub-base and binder against design, by laser scan. Full-surface heat-maps and pass/fail against your tolerances, next working day.
- [Tarmac Depth Surveys | Asphalt Thickness Laser Scan Surveys | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/tarmac-depth-surveys.html): Tarmac depth surveys that measure the asphalt thickness laid everywhere, without cores. Before-and-after laser scan surveys mapped against your spec.
- [Plot & Oversite Surveys | As-Built Slab & Drain Checks | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/plot-oversite-surveys.html): As-built plot and oversite surveys by laser scan: slab flatness, brickwork to drawing and drain collar positions. Pass/fail report per plot, next day.
- [As-Built Surveys | Laser Scan As-Built Drawings for Groundworks | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/as-built-surveys.html): As-built surveys of roads, kerbs, drainage covers, plots and external works by laser scan. As-built drawings in DWG and PDF with the point cloud. From £595.
- [Floor Flatness Surveys | Slab & Screed Flatness by Laser Scan | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/floor-flatness-surveys.html): Floor flatness surveys of concrete slabs and screeds by laser scan: full-floor heat-maps, BS 8204 SR class checks and TR34 free-movement reporting. From £325.
- [Measured Building Surveys | 3D Laser Scan Floor Plans & Elevations | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/measured-building-surveys.html): Measured building surveys by 3D laser scan for kitchens, extensions, architects and interiors. Floor plans, elevations, sections and point cloud. From £325.
- [Topographical Surveys | Laser Scan Topo Surveys for Planning & Sites | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/topographical-surveys.html): Topographical surveys by 3D laser scan for architects, developers and self-builders: levels, contours, boundaries, trees, buildings and drainage. From £595.
- [Groundworks & Civils Design Audit | Drawing Review | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/groundworks-design-audit.html): Independent review of groundworks and civils drawings before you dig: levels, drainage, foundations and clashes checked, with an issue log and fixes. From £495.
- [Garden Surveys | Garden Level & Landscape Laser Scan Surveys | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/garden-surveys.html): Garden surveys by 3D laser scan for garden designers, landscapers and homeowners. Levels, contours, DPC, walls, steps, trees and drains, plus point cloud. From £395.
- [Drone Surveys | Aerial Mapping, Orthophotos & Site Levels | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/drone-surveys.html): Drone surveys tied to ground control fixed by RTK GNSS: scaled orthophotos, surface models, contours and site plans for construction, land and planning. From £450.
- [Stockpile Volume Surveys | Drone Stockpile Measurement | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/stockpile-volume-surveys.html): Stockpile volume surveys by drone with RTK ground control: cubic metres and tonnage for every heap of stone, topsoil, sand and recycled aggregate. From £395 per visit.
- [Earthworks Volume Surveys | Cut & Fill, Topsoil Strip & Muck Shift | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/earthworks-volume-surveys.html): Earthworks volume surveys by drone and RTK GNSS: cut and fill against design, topsoil strip depth, muck-away and import checks, with heat-maps and quantities. From £595.
- [Construction Progress Drone Surveys | Monthly Site Records | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/site-progress-surveys.html): Monthly drone progress surveys for construction sites: scaled orthophoto, aerial photos from fixed viewpoints and a month-on-month comparison for valuations and reporting. From £295 a visit.
- [GNSS Setting Out Services | Site Control, Pegs & Levels | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/setting-out.html): RTK GNSS setting out for groundworks and civils: site control on OS grid, earthworks and drainage pegs, road and kerb offsets, plot dig pegs and levels. Half day from £325.
- [As-Laid Service Surveys | Drainage & Duct Records Before Backfill | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/as-laid-service-surveys.html): As-laid surveys of drainage, ducts and utilities in open trench by RTK GNSS: positions, levels, depths and photos recorded before backfill, with DWG, PDF and CSV records. From £325 a visit.
- [Pre-Start Condition Surveys | Highway & Neighbour Records | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/condition-surveys.html): Pre-start condition surveys before groundworks: dated laser scan, drone and photo records of roads, footpaths, kerbs, boundary walls and neighbouring properties. From £395.
- [Drone Roof Surveys | Roof Inspections & Measured Roof Reports | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/drone-roof-surveys.html): Drone roof surveys without ladders or scaffold: close-up photos of tiles, ridges, chimneys, flashings and gutters, plus measured roof areas and pitches. From £175.
- [Survey Data Processing & Reporting | Point Cloud & Levels QC | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/survey-data-reporting.html): Already have a scan, drone survey or your engineer's levels? We process your survey data and report it against design: heat-maps, pass/fail and thickness. No site visit.
- [Survey Services | Laser Scanning, Drone & GNSS Surveys | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/services.html): Every Dimensure survey: laser scan QC of roads and plots, drone surveys, stockpile and earthworks volumes, GNSS setting out, as-laid and condition surveys, measured, topographical and roof surveys.

## Case studies

- [Case Studies: Groundworks Design Audits & Survey Savings | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/case-studies.html): Real Dimensure case studies for housebuilders and contractors: the problems found on drawings and on site, and the potential savings against the cost of fixing them later.
- [Case Study: 22 Missing Road Gullies Found Before Build | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/case-study-missing-road-gullies.html): A drainage design audit on a 200-300 plot housing scheme found 22 missing road gullies at kerb build-outs before construction. Potential saving: £99,000, 55x the audit fee.
- [Case Study: Thin Tarmac Found Before Adoption, Core Confirmed | Dimensure](https://dimensure.co.uk/case-study-tarmac-thickness.html): A tarmac thickness survey on a new estate road found the base and binder 69 mm thin at the centre line. A core matched the survey to within 3 mm. A 25 m length had to come out. Potential cost avoided: about £23,000.
